summary: Retested the repaired project route and full core workflows. Backend CRUD, deterministic analysis, Indonesian spreadsheet import, PDF response, auth cookies, lockout, and logout passed. Browser project navigation, controls, manual strength/slump persistence, analysis, mobile menu, theme toggle, and logout passed.

critical.issue: Public API emits Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * for both configured and untrusted origins, despite backend/server.py using FRONTEND_ORIGIN. This conflicts with credentialed CORS and indicates an ingress/proxy configuration override.

integration_issues.issue: Google sign-in is not implemented; login UI states it can be connected when project credentials are supplied.

issues: Recharts logs width/height -1 warnings during initial render before the chart container settles.

action_items: Inspect the public ingress/proxy CORS layer and remove wildcard headers; preserve explicit FRONTEND_ORIGIN with credentials.
Implement Google sign-in or remove it from the accepted feature scope.
Optionally stabilize the Recharts container dimensions to remove initial width/height warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: The application code sets explicit credentialed CORS, but the externally observable API still returns wildcard CORS headers; verify deployment routing and proxy middleware rather than only backend source.
Google authentication is absent rather than mocked, so the requested auth choice is not covered by the implementation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of executed core flows; Google sign-in unimplemented

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_CQAS_* and UI-S-ITER2B/UI-SL-ITER2B records through existing regression/UI workflows; these remain in the seeded project. Lockout test used a unique unknown identifier and created no user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ProjectDetail destroy-is-not-a-function crash is resolved. Re-run public CORS checks after ingress/proxy changes and verify Google auth if added. Upload review/import and PDF were verified at API level; browser upload review was not exercised with a real file in this iteration.
rca of the issue: The prior ProjectDetail crash was caused by passing an Axios Promise-returning load function directly to useEffect; the current wrapped effect renders and all tested project interactions work. The remaining CORS discrepancy is external: direct public responses add wildcard Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers although server.py configures FRONTEND_ORIGIN, so an upstream proxy/ingress is overriding application headers.
